picks.title: #1202 - Three Coincidences That Prove God Exists
picks.summary:
In this episode, Trent Horn examines three major coincidences that make atheism increasingly difficult to accept: the fine-tuning of the universe, the strange reality of objective moral facts, and the massive number of miracle claims throughout history. Taken together, these point toward a universe that looks far more like the product of design, purpose, and divine action than random chance.

The Argument for God Atheists Fear the Most: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_jgh9M2z8n0

picks.reason: Argues for divine design through fine-tuning, morality, and miracles, engaging ultimate questions.

picks.title: Episode 388: Are You Actually a Christian? | feat. Granger Smith
picks.summary: This week we sit down with country music artist turned pastor and author Granger Smith to talk about his new book Poison the Well — and the question he asks almost every single day: are you actually a Christian, or have you just checked the box? Granger shares how his own faith unraveled and was rebuilt from the ground up, why he's passionate about sharing the gospel with Christians, and what it really means to follow Jesus beyond an altar call. Pick up Poison the Well wherever books are sold! https://a.co/d/0hQWM5I7

picks.title: Andrew Huberman: The Simple Habits That Will Transform Your Health
picks.summary:
Jay welcomes neuroscientist Andrew Huberman back for his third appearance to dive into his new book, Protocols: An Operating Manual for the Human Body. Andrew breaks down what’s really happening in your body from the moment you wake up, from morning cortisol and better sleep to the science behind that afternoon energy crash. Then the conversation goes beyond physical health, exploring prayer, surrender, and  how to better manage your energy.

With Love and Gratitude,
